answer: Social Matters >> Rights & Etiquettes Question ID: 1632 Country: Canada Title: Can Muslims call non-Muslims as brothers and sisters as human beings? Please provide the reference to the Holy Qur'an or Ahadith if there are any? Question: Can Muslims call non-Muslims as brothers and sisters as human beings? Please provide the reference to the Holy Qur'an or Ahadith if there are any? Answer ID: 1632 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 534/523=D) On human ground, there is no wrong in calling them as brothers. In the Quran, Allah has called prophet as the brother of his peoples: والی عاد اخاھم ھودا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
